verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at workos.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at workos.com/docs.md. Per-page markdown docs (e.g. /docs/sso.md, /docs/mcp.md) and a machine-readable openapi.json give agents clean, agent-oriented entry points. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and no evidence of an expanded full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).
